import Sigma.FunctionSpaces
import Mathlib.Topology.Compactification.OnePoint.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.BooleanSubalgebra

/-! The concrete topology described in Section 3.1. Its properties are proved in
Topology, AtomicRepresentation and ContinuousRepresentation.
-/
namespace SigmaNonprimarity

/-- The base points and one limit point for each member of B. -/
abbrev MrowkaBase (B : Set (Set Point)) := Point ⊕ B

def tailNeighborhood (B : Set (Set Point)) (b : B) (F : Finset Point) : Set (MrowkaBase B) :=
  {p | p = Sum.inr b ∨ ∃ x ∈ b.val, x ∉ F ∧ p = Sum.inl x}

instance mrowkaTopology (B : Set (Set Point)) : TopologicalSpace (MrowkaBase B) :=
  TopologicalSpace.generateFrom
    ({U | ∃ p : Point, U = {Sum.inl p}} ∪
      {U | ∃ b : B, ∃ F : Finset Point, U = tailNeighborhood B b F})

/-- The Alexandrov--Urysohn compactification K_B includes its infinity point. -/
abbrev AUCompactum (B : Set (Set Point)) := OnePoint (MrowkaBase B)

/-- The Boolean algebra generated by B and every finite subset of the base. -/
def generatedAlgebra (B : Set (Set Point)) : BooleanSubalgebra (Set Point) :=
  BooleanSubalgebra.closure (B ∪ {s | s.Finite})

/-- Topological properties discharged by `compactumProperties` in Sigma.Topology. -/
def CompactumProperties (B : Set (Set Point)) : Prop :=
  AlmostDisjoint B → T2Space (MrowkaBase B) ∧ LocallyCompactSpace (MrowkaBase B) ∧
    CompactSpace (AUCompactum B) ∧ T2Space (AUCompactum B)

end SigmaNonprimarity
